fields.title: Assign RPO and RTO
fields.promptBlocks/0/text: For each data type, assign and justify.
fields.promptBlocks/1/text: Orders 2. Catalog from supplier 3. Support chat history 4. Analytics events 5. User-uploaded photos
fields.referenceReasoningBlocks/0/text: 1 — RPO 5 minutes, RTO 1 hour: unrecoverable and critical. 2 — RPO 24 hours, RTO hours: recoverable from source. 3 — RPO 1 hour, RTO hours: unrecoverable, but does not block the product. 4 — RPO 24 hours, RTO 2 days: recalculated from events. 5 — RPO 24 hours, RTO 24 hours: unrecoverable, but does not block. Rule of thumb: the main question is not "how important is it", but "where do we get it if we lose it".
